activation_rule: Run only when research_results/r5_cross_margin_dislocation_001/STATUS_INFRASTRUCTURE_BLOCKED.txt proves that the official Binance Vision route lacks the required historical BBO or tick source.

source.source_identity: Canonical URL, response headers, bytes and SHA-256 per gzip; missing files or schemas fail closed.
source.limitation: Public first-day samples are systematic but incomplete. Passing them requires a full independently registered tick dataset before a 1% daily target test or Champion proposal.

development_days: remaining UTC first calendar days of every month in 2022 and 2023, opened only after the pilot gate
selection_days: UTC first calendar days of 2024, opened only after frozen development pass
confirmation_days: UTC first calendar days of 2025, opened only after one frozen 2024 primary

causality.bucket: non-overlapping completed 100ms/500ms/1s local-arrival buckets, available only at bucket end
causality.entry: first actual USD-M quote local_timestamp at or after bucket end plus registered latency
causality.same_time: adverse ordering when exact order is unresolved

parameters_and_gates: Identical to preregistration.json; no fee, latency, threshold, risk, leverage or gate changes are permitted.
